scenario_description: Elena accepts a March 16 assignment that requires driving from Dominion Middle School to Indianola K-8 School with classroom materials. At first, the usual parking arrangements appear available, but a confirmed resurfacing project later closes Dominion's free east lot for the entire morning. The temporary overflow lot is farther away, has limited spaces, and requires a temporary parking pass that must be requested from the school office. The risk becomes sufficiently observable when the closure and pass requirement are confirmed in event3: without preparing an alternate arrival plan and requesting the pass, Elena could arrive late, be unable to park legally, or miss the material transfer. Later messages narrow the available parking options and confirm the morning's tight handoff time.

parameter.subject: March 16 substitute assignment confirmed
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Monday, March 16, 2026. Report to Dominion Middle School, 330 E Dominion Boulevard, by 7:20 AM. After the morning class, take two labeled classroom-material bins to Indianola K-8 School for a 12:30 PM handoff, then return to Dominion for the afternoon coverage.

parameter.subject: Parking information for March 16 assignment
parameter.body: The normal east lot at Dominion is currently listed as available for substitutes on March 16. Please use the main office entrance when you arrive and allow time to check in before going to class.

parameter.subject: Confirmed east-lot closure at Dominion on March 16
parameter.body: The east parking lot at Dominion will be closed for resurfacing from 6:30 AM through 1:00 PM on Monday, March 16. Substitutes cannot leave cars in the staff lot during that work. The school office can issue a temporary parking pass for the North Broadway overflow lot, about a ten-minute walk from the main entrance, but the pass has to be requested before Friday afternoon.

parameter.subject: Overflow parking pass request details
parameter.body: We can prepare one temporary pass for Elena Brooks for the North Broadway overflow lot on March 16. Please reply with the vehicle make, color, and license plate by 3:00 PM Friday, March 13. The overflow lot is shared with morning visitors and may fill after 7:15 AM; the pass does not reserve a space.

parameter.content: The bins must leave Dominion by 11:45 on Monday so they reach Indianola before the 12:30 lesson. The office will be busy with morning visitors, so please plan to arrive early enough to park, walk in, and check in without cutting into the handoff time.
